variants.suspected_cause: The target's swap/clr/swap sequence extracts the high word before 16-bit modulo; division by 65536 may select that word directly in the compiler.
variants.controlled_change: Replace only the two constant right shifts by unsigned-long division by 65536L.

predicted_effect.note: High-word division should use a two-byte-longer word-swap sequence for each of the two random values.
